Point cloud mobjects

Source: R/point_cloud.R
point_cloud.Rd

PMobject is a mobject made of points drawn as small squares, each with its own color (the rgbas matrix, one row per point). Mobject1D and Mobject2D add a sampling density. PGroup() groups point clouds, PointCloudDot() is a disc filled with points and Point() is a single point.

Usage

PMobject(stroke_width = DEFAULT_STROKE_WIDTH, ...)

Mobject1D(density = DEFAULT_POINT_DENSITY_1D, ...)

Mobject2D(density = DEFAULT_POINT_DENSITY_2D, ...)

PGroup(...)

PointCloudDot(
  center = ORIGIN,
  radius = 2,
  stroke_width = 2,
  density = DEFAULT_POINT_DENSITY_1D,
  color = PURE_YELLOW,
  ...
)

Point(location = ORIGIN, color = BLACK, ...)

Arguments

stroke_width

Drawn size of each point.

...

Further named arguments passed to MobjectClass, or for PGroup() the point cloud mobjects to group.

density

Number of sample points per unit length (1D) or per unit area (2D).

center, radius

Center and radius of the disc of points.

color

Color of the points.

location

Position of the point.

Value

A mobject: an R6 object of the class named by the function called. The objects whose names end in Class are the R6 class generators that these functions call.

Examples

cloud <- PointCloudDot(radius = 1, density = 20, color = BLUE)
cloud$thin_out(2)
g <- PGroup(PointCloudDot(), Point(RIGHT))
